name: LSST/Rubin Alert Stream
description: Time-domain alert packets generated by the Rubin Observatory Legacy Survey of Space and Time Prompt Processing pipeline, describing detections of variable and transient sources. Loader-only metadata; no alert data dump is vendored.
citation: Graham, M. L., Bellm, E. C., Guy, L. P., Slater, C. T., Dubois-Felsmann, G. P., Jurić, M., & Rubin Observatory Data Management System Science Team. LSST Alerts: Key Numbers. DMTN-102 (2024). https://dmtn-102.lsst.io/

license.notes: The license for the LSST alert stream is unverified; no license is specified on the upstream documentation page.
